reply_text:
I saved a draft in Anselm's mailbox to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com). The subject is "Quarrendon Freight Lines – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". The draft gives the rate as $2,356 per seat and is signed from Anselm. It hasn't been sent; Anselm will need to review and send it himself. I told him this in a reply to his message in your direct message.

No approval request was needed:
- **The rate:** A per-seat rate normally can't go to Hollis without approval from Anselm or June. Anselm is the CFO and agreed in his message, so that approval is covered.
- **The address:** Hollis has a pemberline.com address, so the rule needing Ruth Calloway's approval for outside addresses doesn't apply.
